title: FBI Agent’s Daughter Thinks She’s Above The Law
description:
On January 8th, 2023, officers were dispatched in response to a report of an intoxicated woman causing a disturbance after being deboarded from a flight. Despite being requested multiple times, the woman refused to come out of the washroom. The woman continued to argue with the officers and was unwilling to cooperate. Soon, the woman became increasingly resistant, making it more difficult for the officers. The woman began to behave very disruptively and kicked one of the officers. Shortly thereafter, the woman was transported to jail for further processing. Even in jail, the woman remained highly uncooperative. The female was charged with public intoxication, battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
